description: This Java source file defines a JUnit test execution listener `StartModuleExecutionListener` that manages startup and shutdown of OpenMRS modules for testing purposes, including dynamic bean registration and refresh of the application context.

classes.name: StartModuleExecutionListener
classes.description: A test execution listener that manages the startup and shutdown of OpenMRS modules during tests, including refreshing the application context to reflect module changes.

methods.name: prepareTestInstance
methods.description: Prepares the test instance before execution, including loading specified modules, starting them, and refreshing the application context.

methods.name: removeFilteredBeanDefinitions
methods.description: Removes specific bean definitions from the application context to prepare for module startups.

methods.name: afterTestClass
methods.description: Cleans up after the test class execution by re-registering removed bean definitions and shutting down modules.
